rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physical, logical, or mental distance.

example.english: That village is distant from the urban area.
example.jyutping: go2 tiu4 cyun1 lei4 si5 keoi1 hou2 jyun5

rows.note: Use this when someone is emotionally unresponsive or shows little warmth toward another person.

example.english: They've been very distant toward me lately.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 deoi3 ngo5 hou2 laang5 daam6
